metadata.name: Quality and deployment runbook
metadata.origen: Structure derived from an operations example. Commands come from the repository and the SAD, not from the example.

secciones.seccion: Quality gates. Use quality-pipeline.xml identifiers. Do not invent a second gate numbering.
Promotion sequence and rollback sequence. Each step names the real workflow file or script when one exists, otherwise PENDING.
Checklists for cutover, pre-production review, rollback, and manual accessibility. A checklist item without an owner stays open.
Diagrams link to docs/design/diagrams/. They are not a second copy.
Procedures that are not written yet are listed as pending. Do not fill them from another project.

prompt.regla: The runbook must agree with the current SAD and the CI files in the repository. A contradiction is recorded, not smoothed over.
